title: Al-Mutaffifin 83:19-24 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Mutaffifin and the sifat of weakness and emphasis
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Mutaffifin 83:19-24 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 24. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ (١٩) كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ (٢٠) يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ (٢١) إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ (٢٢) عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ (٢٣) تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ (٢٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Mutaffifin 83:19-24 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 83:19-24 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 83:19-24 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, find the itbaq letter in 83:24.
Compare 83:7 to 9 with 83:18 to 20. What is the same and what is different?
questions.a: Both describe a written register; the wicked's is in sijjin, the righteous' in 'illiyyin.
A) In pleasure (na'im). 83:22: 'Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure.'

questions.q: Think again: The righteous sit on couches looking, and 'you will recognise in their faces the radiance of pleasure' (83:24). What deeds today might lead there?
questions.a: Honesty, prayer, kindness, patience: the opposite of cheating and denying.
